title: Meso-vein MRI · native healthy participant 01

images.name: Native magnitude · stored echo 3 · participant 01, run 01

space.name: Meso-vein participant 01 · original run 01 space
space.reference: Original 572 x 572 x 370 x 3 NIfTI sequence, coded qform and sform, millimeter units, oblique voxel-to-RAS geometry.
space.correspondence: One native source run, with exact selection of stored frame index 2. No motion correction, interpolation, averaging, vessel segmentation, cross-subject registration or correspondence with another atlas is added.

sources.title: Whole-brain meso-vein imaging in living humans using fast 7-T MRI
sources.citation: Gulban OF et al. Whole-brain meso-vein imaging in living humans using fast 7-T MRI. Science Advances 12(2), eaea4540 (2026). doi:10.1126/sciadv.aea4540. Dataset doi:10.5281/zenodo.19332208. Selected original participant 01, session 06, run 01, stored echo frame 3.

scope_notes: The source publication describes five healthy participants. This package retains one original run from participant 01; it supplies no named venous branch or individual normal-variant annotation.
The stored native spacing is approximately 0.34965 x 0.34965 x 0.35 mm. Original anisotropy, obliquity and field of view are preserved; no source-author 2x interpolated product is used.

Stored frame 3 is selected exactly from the three-frame source series. Echo time is not assigned because the selected source header and publication protocol differ; original header provenance is retained.

Dark image signal requires anatomical interpretation in adjacent sections. It is not a venous segmentation or a verified boundary. A single run may contain motion, distortion and susceptibility-related loss.
A participant number does not validate registration to separately supplied T1 images or another atlas. Other native comparisons remain independent.
acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire mesoveins --data-root <data-root>. Download the pinned source archive once and extract only the selected original participant/run. Completed extraction is reused.

archives.hash_basis: Local SHA256 of official download verified against publisher MD5
